description: Parameters for stopping one named runtime instance.

runtime.description: Stable provider type; it MUST equal the instance's immutable runtimeType.

operationId.description: Server switch operation this request belongs to. Sent only to Connectors that declare the switchFence feature, always together with switchRevision.

switchRevision.description: Monotonic switch revision of this runtime instance. The Connector rejects a revision lower than the accepted one, or the accepted revision with another operationId, with code switch_revision_stale.

title: RuntimeStopParams
